Name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3
Purpose: USB HID controller, serial transport, and 3.3 V supply
Fit / Notes: Install in two 7-position 2.54 mm female sockets. USB-C faces the board edge marked USB-C ACCESS.

Name: XIAO 7-position female socket header
Purpose: Removable PCB socket for the XIAO ESP32-S3
Fit / Notes: Two single-row sockets are required; verify pin 1 and installed height before manufacture.

Name: XIAO 7-position male header
Purpose: Headers soldered to the removable XIAO ESP32-S3
Fit / Notes: Two single-row headers mate with the PCB sockets; the XIAO module is supplied without these headers.

Name: Newhaven 20x4 Character OLED Display
Fit / Notes: Exact 20-pin display and matching custom footprint.

Name: Newhaven 20-position female socket header
Purpose: Removable PCB socket for the character display
Fit / Notes: One 20-position 2.54 mm socket; verify pin 1, installed height, and display clearance.

Name: Newhaven 20-position male header
Purpose: Header soldered to the character display
Fit / Notes: One 20-position 2.54 mm header mates with the PCB socket.

Name: 0.96-inch 128x64 I2C OLED Module
Fit / Notes: Use the 26 mm x 26 mm I2C module matching the listed custom footprint.

Name: Graphical OLED 4-position female socket header
Purpose: Removable PCB socket for the graphical display
Fit / Notes: One 4-position 2.54 mm socket; verify GND pin 1 and installed height.

Name: Graphical OLED 4-position male header
Purpose: Header soldered to the graphical display
Fit / Notes: One 4-position 2.54 mm header mates with the PCB socket.

Name: MCP23017 16-bit I2C GPIO expander
Fit / Notes: Use the SPDIP-28 package shown by the PCB footprint. Do not substitute SOIC or SSOP.

Name: 28-pin 0.3-inch DIP socket
Fit / Notes: Align the socket notch and MCP23017 pin 1 with the U3 marking.

Name: Alps Alpine EC11E rotary encoder with push switch
Purpose: Two rotary inputs for Blip controls
Fit / Notes: Both encoder footprints use the same 20 mm vertical EC11E pattern. Confirm shaft, detent, mounting-tab, and knob clearance.

Name: Cherry MX PCB-mount mechanical keyswitch
Purpose: Twelve switches in the 4-row by 3-column matrix
Fit / Notes: Through-hole Cherry MX 1.00u footprint. Keycaps are not included.

Name: 1N4148 through-hole switching diode
Purpose: Prevents ghosting in the switch matrix
Fit / Notes: Twelve axial DO-35 diodes, one per switch position.

Name: 4.7 kOhm 1% 0805 resistor
Purpose: I2C pull-ups on the shared bus
Fit / Notes: Two hand-solder 0805 resistors. The graphical OLED module also contains its own pull-ups; the combined bus strength is documented separately.

Name: 100 nF 50 V X7R 0805 ceramic capacitor
Purpose: Local 3.3 V decoupling at the controller/expander rail
